title: S3.7c SAB 21800 exact coedge next-ring closure
scope: Use the reviewed SAB 21800 loop-start and next-link pointer ordinals instead of first-type-match lookup
Expose whether a rooted coedge ring returns to its starting coedge
Classify missing or non-start cycle closure as a known projection gap

implementation.profile: ACIS BinaryFile SAB 21800 only for exact pointer ordinals and closure status
implementation.closureRule: Closed only when the exact coedge-next walk revisits its starting coedge. A null/absent next pointer or cycle that enters another already-seen coedge remains unclosed.
implementation.coverageRule: An observed unclosed ring sets projected coverage to ProjectedSubsetWithKnownGaps; no B-rep validity is inferred.
implementation.compatibility: DRW_AcisFaceLoop layout changes; downstream consumers must rebuild. DRW_Interface vtable and 2D callbacks are unchanged.

positive: Generated two-loop graph reports exact next-link ring closure for each loop
Parser-fed SAB projection preserves closure state alongside ordered coedge identities
negative: Parser-fed coedge with null next but non-null previous/partner links is not extended using those links
The partial coedge row remains visible, reports unclosed status, and classifies as a known gap
